test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following article says that 'It shall be the duty of every citizen of India who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward between the age of six and fourteen years'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51A(k)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51A(k) **of the Constitution of India states that it is the duty of every citizen who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to their child or ward between the age of **six** and **fourteen years**.
 
• This article falls under** Part IV-A** of the Constitution which deals with fundamental duties of citizens.
 
• **This article specifically addresses the duty of parents and guardians to provide education to their children.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 51A(j), states that it is the duty of every citizen to strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity.
 
• 51A(i), states that it is the duty of every citizen to safeguard public property and to abjure violence.
 
• **51A(h), states that it is the duty of every citizen to develop the scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.**
